metaDescription: Six floor cushions compared on thickness, foam fill, cover fabric, footprint and set size for living room lounging, reading nooks and kids play.
expertTake: The Degrees of Comfort 22 inch round set is the best overall pick for its balanced foam blend and corduroy cover. The 1 Middle One set is the value pick for occasional seating. Anyone who plans to sit on the floor for long stretches should skip thin cushions and choose a 5 or 6 inch model, or buy a proper chair.
introParagraphs: A floor cushion is extra seating that disappears when you do not need it. In a living room it covers the overflow at a coffee table, makes a reading corner, and gives kids and guests somewhere to sit without another chair taking up floor space.

The word cushion hides big differences. Thickness, fill and cover fabric decide whether you sit comfortably for an hour or give up in ten minutes. This guide compares six sets, including a kids pack, and is honest about when a floor cushion is the wrong tool.

products.name: Degrees of Comfort 22 Inch Round Meditation Cushions, Set of 2

specList.label: Fill
specList.value: Shredded memory foam with supportive foam

products.description:
Degrees of Comfort makes a 22 inch round set with 4 inches of thickness, filled with a blend of shredded memory foam and a firmer supportive foam. The listing says the round surface gives adults room to sit cross legged, and the blend is the key: pure shredded memory foam moulds and then collapses, while the added support foam stops it bottoming out. A ribbed corduroy cover adds breathable texture.

The tradeoff is thickness. Four inches is enough for a cross legged sit or a seat at a low table, but a heavier adult kneeling or sitting with legs straight will compress it, and the HIGOGOGO at 6 inches or the JKMAX at 5 inches gives more depth. Against the Codi, the Degrees round is more compact but less roomy. Against the 1 Middle One, it is thicker and has the more considered blend.

It suits a coffee table nook, a meditation corner or a pair for kids and adults at a movie night. Give the cushions a day or two after unboxing to expand, then fluff by hand. In year three, expect the corduroy to hold up while the top foam softens slightly, and plan to wipe it down rather than wash the foam.
products.bestFor: Everyday adult seating at a coffee table, reading corner or meditation spot.
pros: Foam blend resists collapsing the way pure shredded fill does
Round 22 inch top suits cross legged sitting
Corduroy cover feels breathable and masks small marks
A set of two covers a pair of guests
cons: Four inches of thickness compresses under heavier adults
Round shape wastes floor area versus a square cushion

products.name: JKMAX 22 Inch High Density Foam Floor Pillows, 5 Inch, Set of 2
products.description:
JKMAX offers 22 by 22 inch squares at 5 inches thick, filled with high density foam rather than loose fill, and covered in a velvety plush fabric. The listing also pitches it for outdoor use. Solid or dense foam gives the same firm lift on day one and on day 300, which is the right behaviour for a cushion you sit on every evening.

The tradeoff is that plush collects pet hair, lint and crumbs more than a corduroy weave, and a firmer foam does not contour the way memory foam does. If you want a pillow that moulds around you, the Degrees or zen shi fu style fills are softer. Against the HIGOGOGO, it is a pair rather than a single and a little thinner. Against the Sibosen kids set, it is a real adult seat.

It suits a living room with children, a game corner or a spot beside a fireplace. Vacuum the plush with a soft brush weekly, and spot clean with a damp cloth. The cover should be checked for zipper access, since washing is easier if it comes off. Over a few years, expect the plush to flatten where it is sat on most, and rotate the pair so wear spreads.
products.bestFor: Adults who want a thick, firm seat and a soft cover.
pros: Five inch thickness holds an adult better than four inch models
High density foam keeps its height rather than packing down
Square 22 inch footprint stacks and tucks into corners
Plush cover feels soft and suits a media corner
cons: Plush fabric collects hair and dust faster than corduroy
Firm foam does not contour as softly as shredded memory foam

products.name: HIGOGOGO 6 Inch Extra Thick Floor Pillow, 22 Inch, Tufted Corduroy
products.description:
HIGOGOGO sells a single 22 by 22 inch cushion that is 6 inches thick when fully expanded, filled with high density foam and covered in tufted corduroy with a carry handle. The maker states it will seat two children or one adult, which is a more honest framing than most floor cushion claims. At 6 inches it is the thickest cushion in this group.

The tradeoff is that it is sold as a single piece at the upper tier, so a pair costs twice as much, and the vacuum packed foam needs a couple of days to reach its full height. The tufting dents the surface in a deliberate way, but also traps crumbs. Compared with the Degrees round set, it is thicker but not a set. Against the JKMAX, it is thicker and firmer.

It works as a floor seat for an adult who wants real support, as a reading cushion against the sofa, and as a floor level extra seat that can be carried by the handle. Unpack it a day early, since a compressed cushion feels thin. In year three, brush out crumbs from the tufts, and watch the corners, where handles and seams take strain.
products.bestFor: Heavier adults and anyone who wants the most thickness in a single cushion.
pros: Six inches of thickness is the deepest seat in the group
High density foam keeps its shape in daily use
A carry handle makes moving it between rooms easy
Tufted corduroy cover gives a firm, tailored look
cons: Sold as a single cushion at an upper cost tier
Tufts trap crumbs and need brushing out

products.name: Codi 32 Inch Round Floor Pillows, Mandala Design, Set of 2
products.description:
Codi makes a 32 inch round cushion, about as wide as a standard interior door, with a shredded memory foam blend and a symmetrical mandala pattern. At that diameter it is closer to a small mat than a seat cushion, and an adult can sit with legs folded or lean back. The size is the entire reason to consider it.

The tradeoff is footprint and cost tier: two 32 inch circles take about as much floor as a small armchair, and the set sits near the top of the cost range. Memory foam shredded this finely tends to flatten under body weight, and the listing does not give a thickness figure, which is a gap. Against the Degrees round set, it is roomier but not necessarily more supportive.

It suits an open living room with a bare floor, a yoga corner or a children play area. Unpack it two days early, shake the fill and rotate it. Expect to spot clean the printed cover, and expect the centre to flatten faster than the edge, so flip and rotate it weekly.
products.bestFor: Open rooms and lounging where you want a wide, lie-down surface.
pros: A 32 inch diameter gives room to sit, sprawl or lean
Shredded memory foam contours softly to the body
Symmetrical mandala design looks styled on a plain rug
Pair covers two people or two cushions stacked
cons: No thickness figure in the listing, so support is uncertain
Takes a lot of floor space for its comfort level

products.name: 1 Middle One Memory Foam Floor Pillow Set of 2, 20 Inch Square
products.description:
1 Middle One sells a pair of 20 by 20 inch cushions that are 2.7 to 3 inches thick, filled with shredded memory foam. They are pitched for adults and kids who read, watch television and play. This is the thinnest and most affordable adult set here, and it is honest about the thickness.

The tradeoff is depth. Under three inches, a cushion compresses fully under an adult within minutes, so you sit on the floor with a thin pad. It is better as an extra seat for kids, a pad for stool height or a cushion for a short time at a coffee table. Against the Degrees round set, it is thinner and cheaper. Against the JKMAX at 5 inches, it is about half as deep.

In a living room it suits occasional seating, movie night and kids. In year three, expect it to feel flatter, and treat the set as consumable rather than permanent seating. Wash only the cover if it comes off, and avoid putting the foam in a washer.
products.bestFor: Occasional seating, kids and shorter sessions on a budget.
pros: Lowest cost tier for a set of two adult sized cushions
Shredded memory foam moulds quickly to the body
Compact 20 inch squares tuck under a console
Suitable for kids and adults alike
cons: Under three inches thick compresses fast under an adult
Thin profile makes long sittings uncomfortable on hard floors

products.name: Sibosen 6 Piece 16 Inch Round Floor Cushions, Mixed Colours
products.description:
Sibosen packs six 16 inch round cushions in six colours, with a brushed polyester cover over a soft fill. The listing frames them for kids and adults and as flexible seating chair pads. They are a play and classroom cushion, not a meditation set, and the pack is sized for a group.

The tradeoff is that 16 inches is small for an adult, and the soft fill compresses quickly, so these are cushions for children or quick seating. They are also not a comfortable pad for long sits on a hard floor. Against the Degrees set, they are smaller and less supportive but cheaper per seat. Against the 1 Middle One, they are rounder and come as a larger pack.

In a living room they suit a kids play corner, a movie night with several children, or stacked as a pouf. Wipe the covers with a damp cloth and fluff them often. Expect pilling on the brushed surface after a year or two, and replace any that flatten.
products.bestFor: Kids play corners, movie nights and group seating on a small budget.
pros: Six cushions cover a group of children at once
Round 16 inch size is easy for small hands to carry
Six colours help kids keep their own seat
Low cost per seat compared with adult sets
cons: Sixteen inches is too small for comfortable adult sitting
Soft fill flattens quickly with daily use

buyingCriteria.explanation: Thickness is the main comfort variable. Under 3 inches, like the 1 Middle One, compresses fully under an adult, while 4 to 6 inches, as on the Degrees, JKMAX and HIGOGOGO, keeps a seated adult off the floor. Heavier users should start at 5 inches, and every cushion needs 24 to 72 hours to expand before you judge it.

Shredded memory foam moulds to the body and recovers slowly, while dense solid foam holds its height. Cheap polyfill flattens first. A blend, as on the Degrees, gives some of each, and the common mistake is assuming memory foam is automatically firm.

A 22 inch round suits cross legged sitting, while a 22 inch square tucks into corners and stacks. A 32 inch round like the Codi takes a lot of floor. Measure the space under your coffee table before buying.

Corduroy hides wear, plush collects hair, and brushed polyester pills over time. A full length zipper lets you wash the cover, and foam never goes in a washer. Check that the zipper is hidden and sturdy.
Sets of two suit a pair of seats, and a six pack like the Sibosen suits a group of children. Matching the set to the user avoids buying adult cushions that kids flatten.
Hard floors let cushions slide and feel cold, so a rug underneath helps. Floor seating has no back support, so sit against a sofa or wall for anything over half an hour.

specDecoder.meaning: Memory foam cut into small pieces so the cushion can shift under body weight. It feels soft and moulds easily.
specDecoder.watchFor: The Codi and 1 Middle One use it alone, so expect more flattening than the Degrees blend.

specDecoder.meaning: A denser foam that resists compression. It keeps its height but feels firmer.
specDecoder.watchFor: The JKMAX and HIGOGOGO use it, so expect firm, lasting height.

specDecoder.meaning: The depth of the cushion once expanded. Deeper cushions hold you off the floor longer.
specDecoder.watchFor: The HIGOGOGO lists 6 inches, the JKMAX 5, the Degrees 4 and the 1 Middle One 2.7 to 3.

specDecoder.meaning: A packaging method that squashes foam flat for shipping. The foam needs time to regain its shape.
specDecoder.watchFor: Allow up to 72 hours for the foam to fully expand.

specDecoder.meaning: A ribbed cotton or polyester fabric that is durable and breathable. It hides marks better than smooth fabrics.
specDecoder.watchFor: The Degrees and HIGOGOGO use corduroy, while the JKMAX uses plush.

howWeEvaluated.title: Thickness and fill
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared stated thickness and fill across sets, from 2.7 inches to 6 inches. We matched them to adult and child use. We did not measure compression.

howWeEvaluated.title: Cover fabric
howWeEvaluated.description: We read the cover descriptions, such as corduroy, plush and brushed polyester. We noted which are likely to collect hair or pill. We favoured covers with clear care notes.

howWeEvaluated.title: Footprint
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared 16, 20, 22 and 32 inch sizes against real living room spaces. A cushion that fits under a coffee table scored higher than a rug sized one.

howWeEvaluated.title: Set value
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared set size, from single to six, against real use. We noted that a single HIGOGOGO costs about as much as a pair elsewhere.

howWeEvaluated.title: Owner feedback patterns
howWeEvaluated.description: We researched common complaints about floor cushions, such as flattening and slow expansion. These shaped the cons. We did not use ratings or review counts.

cards.label: Round
cards.text: The Degrees and Codi are round, which suits cross legged sitting and looks softer in a room.

cards.label: Square
cards.text: The JKMAX, HIGOGOGO and 1 Middle One are square, which stack, tuck into corners and use floor area efficiently.

howToChoose.note: Pick round for sitting posture and square for storage and corners.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: At least 4 inches of thickness, a washable cover, and a footprint that fits under a coffee table or against a sofa.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The Degrees round set suits most living rooms, and the HIGOGOGO suits an adult who wants real depth.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: An adult will sit on it daily, you are heavier, or you want a thicker, firmer cushion such as the HIGOGOGO.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: The cushions are for kids, for an occasional guest, or for a short movie night.

maintenance.why: Foam compresses in the same spot, so turning the cushion spreads wear. Shake shredded fill back into shape.
Plush and tufted covers trap crumbs and hair. A soft brush attachment removes them without pulling threads.
Use a damp cloth and mild soap. Soaking the foam can cause mildew, so keep it dry.
If the zipper opens fully, wash the cover on a gentle cycle and air dry. Never wash the foam insert.
Handles and zippers fail first. Repair a split seam early before foam spills out.

faq.q: Are floor cushions comfortable for long sitting?
faq.a: Not usually. With no back support, hips and knees tire, so sit against a sofa and choose 5 inches or more.

faq.q: How thick should a floor cushion be?
faq.a: Four inches is a minimum for adults and 5 to 6 inches suits heavier users. Under three inches is mainly for kids or short sits.

faq.q: Can I wash a floor cushion?
faq.a: Usually only the cover. Foam inserts should not go in a washer, so wipe them and air dry.

faq.q: Why does my new cushion feel flat?
faq.a: Most arrive vacuum compressed. Give it 24 to 72 hours to expand, then fluff by hand.

faq.q: Are floor cushions good for kids?
faq.a: Yes, for play and movie nights. Small sets like the Sibosen are sized for children, but not for adults.

faq.q: Do they slide on hard floors?
faq.a: Often. A rug or a non slip pad under the cushion stops sliding and the cold of a hard floor.
